label: PF Backlog 459
title: DEFECT: validation profiles INTEGRATION/DOGFOOD/RELEASE have unimplemented checkers -> always BLOCKED
body:
Source: found during the BI-PF-0420 360-degree check (2026-10-07).

DEFECT: three validation profiles reference checkers that do not exist, so they always return BLOCKED
(fail-closed), regardless of BI-PF-0420:
- config/validation-profiles.json INTEGRATION lists `cross_contract`
- DOGFOOD lists `e2e`
- RELEASE lists `security`
core/validation_engine.py `_CHECKERS` only implements {quality_gate, tests, policy, verification, pr_gate};
unknown checkers are recorded {"status":"unknown","detail":"no checker (deferred to later ENG phase)"} -> the
verdict gate (all pass/skip + >=1 pass) is not met -> BLOCKED.

Note: the DOGFOOD *validation profile* is distinct from the real dogfood path (core/dogfood.run +
POST /api/v1/validation/dogfood), which does run end to end.

Impact: `POST /validation/run` with profile INTEGRATION|DOGFOOD|RELEASE can never PASS. Not a parallel-
validation problem (BI-PF-0420) - a missing-checker problem.

Fix (proper, not a shortcut): implement the three checkers by delegating to existing owners
(cross_contract -> core.cross_contract / test_framework_integration cross-contract; e2e -> core.dogfood or
test_framework_integration e2e; security -> the existing security scanner(s)), or remove the check from the
profile if it is genuinely out of scope - a decision to take. Then the profiles can PASS.
